title: "TSS_profile_plot_of_DRGs"
output: html_document
editor_options: 
  chunk_output_type: console
---

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86) 
library(rtracklayer)


target_genes_df <- sig_genes_21_to_28 
target_genes_df$gene_id_clean <- gsub("\\..*", "", target_genes_df$gene_id)
target_ids <- unique(target_genes_df$gene_id_clean)


edb <- EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86


genes_gr <- genes(edb, 
                  filter = GeneIdFilter(target_ids),
                  columns = c("gene_id", "symbol"),
                  return.type = "GRanges")



if(length(genes_gr) < length(target_ids)) {
  missing <- setdiff(target_ids, genes_gr$gene_id)
  print(missing)
}

missing_gene_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = "X",           
  ranges = IRanges(start = 154582307, end = 154608358), 
  strand = "-",
  gene_id = "ENSG00000284691",
  symbol = "RP11-511P7.5"   
)


mcols(genes_gr) <- mcols(genes_gr)[, c("gene_id", "symbol")]
genes_gr <- c(genes_gr, missing_gene_gr)




current_levels <- seqlevels(genes_gr)


new_levels <- paste0("chr", current_levels)


new_levels <- gsub("chrMT", "chrM", new_levels)

names(new_levels) <- current_levels
genes_gr <- renameSeqlevels(genes_gr, new_levels)


genes_gr <- keepStandardChromosomes(genes_gr, pruning.mode = "coarse")



export(genes_gr, "CDRS_209_Ensembl_Fixed.bed", format = "bed")


```
